verified_facts.text: COMO Cocoa Island, known locally as Makunufushi, is located among South Male's coral atolls.
verified_facts.excerpt: COMO Cocoa Island, known locally as Makunufushi, is located among South Malé’s coral atolls

verified_facts.text: The island is a 40-minute speedboat transfer from Male International Airport, and guests do not need seaplanes to reach it.
verified_facts.excerpt: our guests do not need seaplanes to access the island — we are just a 40-minute speedboat transfer from Malé International Airport (MLE).

verified_facts.text: The overwater villas are shaped like the curving wooden forms of the local dhoni fishing boats.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our resort is instantly recognisable by overwater villas shaped like the gently curving wooden forms of the local ‘dhoni’ fishing boats.

verified_facts.text: Each bungalow sits above the lagoon, connected by planked walkways.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each bungalow sits above the lagoon, connected by planked walkways.

verified_facts.text: The villas are built with high rafters, glossy teak floors, New Zealand pine and Kajan-thatched roofs.
verified_facts.excerpt: All are built with high rafters, glossy teak floors, New Zealand pine and Kajan-thatched roofs.

verified_facts.text: From the private terrace of each villa, guests can step off and swim in the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: From your private terrace, you can step off and swim in the sea.

verified_facts.text: The two-bedroom COMO Sunrise Villa has separate wings and a private pool directly above the ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our two-bedroom overwater COMO Sunrise Villa has separate wings and a private pool directly above the ocean.

verified_facts.text: The COMO Sunset Villa features two standalone villas connected by a wooden walkway and is named for its sunset views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our three-bedroom COMO Sunset Villa features two standalone villas connected by a wooden walkway and is named for its spectacular sunset views.

verified_facts.text: The COMO Shambhala hydrotherapy pool is one of the few in the Maldives.
verified_facts.excerpt: our hydrotherapy pool — one of the few in the Maldives — offers another way to unwind

verified_facts.text: COMO Shambhala treatment rooms overlook the lagoon and greenery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treatment rooms overlook the lagoon and lush greenery

verified_facts.text: There is a two-storey wellness facility with a yoga pavilion on the top floor and a gym on the lower floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: There is a two-storey wellness facility with a yoga pavilion on the top floor, and a fully equipped gym on the lower floor.

verified_facts.text: The Pilates studio is equipped with a reformer, cadillac, ladder barrel and combo chair.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fully equipped with a reformer, cadillac, ladder barrel and combo chair

verified_facts.text: The UV night snorkel uses special UV torches and mask lenses to reveal fluorescent colours of corals on the house reef at night.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience an underwater light show at COMO Cocoa Island’s house reef. Special UV torches and mask lenses will reveal the stunning hues of fluorescent greens, yellows, reds and oranges emitted at night by various coral species.

verified_facts.text: Dive sites in the atoll include the Kandooma Caves and the shark cleaning station at Cocoa Thila.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our marine-rich atoll is full of pristine dive sites, such as the dramatic Kandooma Caves and the ever-popular shark cleaning station at Cocoa Thila.

verified_facts.text: A complimentary guided house reef snorkel can reveal Kashmir snapper, oriental sweetlips, needlefish and the occasional reef shark.
verified_facts.excerpt: You will discover a diverse array of marine life during this complimentary guided excursion, from schools of Kashmir snapper and oriental sweetlips, to needlefish and the occasional (harmless) reef shark.

verified_facts.text: Guests can sponsor a coral propagating frame and help the resident marine biologist plant it in the resort's coral garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sponsor a coral propagating frame and help our resident marine biologist plant it on the seabed at COMO Cocoa Island’s coral garden.

verified_facts.text: Guests can practise barefoot walking meditation on a sandbank.

verified_facts.text: Ufaa is an inside-outside, pool- and beach-side restaurant serving modern interpretations of Indian and Mediterranean cuisine.

verified_facts.text: For the sandbank picnic, a personal butler serves a three-course meal at a table set up on the island's eastern sandbank.
verified_facts.excerpt: We set up an intimate dining table on COMO Cocoa Island’s eastern sandbank, where your personal butler serves you a three-course picnic meal
